theory.md: В пересказе вопроса порядок слов как в утверждении, без do/did: «Where **do you** live?» → He asked where **I lived**. Вопрос без вопросительного слова — через **if / whether**: «Are you ready?» → She asked **if** I was ready.

cells: He asked where the well was.
She asked if I liked tea.
They asked what I had seen.

theory.md: Вежливые вопросы устроены так же: Can you tell me where **the station is**? (не «where is the station»).

examples.es: She asked me where I was going.
He asked if I had a map.
examples.ru: Он спросил, есть ли у меня карта.

examples.es: Can you tell me what time it is?
I wonder why the city disappeared.

options: He asked where did I live.
He asked where do I live.
exercises.explain: Порядок как в утверждении, без do.

options: She asked if I was tired.
She asked that I was tired.
